chapter_title_en: Storms Stir Beyond the Seas; Bane Lightning and Asura Flames
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 500: Bane Lightning vs. Asura Sacred Flame—The Resource War Begins
chapter_meta_description: Han Li pushes Xuan Gu to a forced fusion of the Asura Sacred Flame—a dangerous gamble that reveals the ghost elder’s true desperation.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 500: The Golden Lightning Sphere That Broke a Ghost Elder’s Confidence
og_description: When your enemy’s last trump card is a self-destruct button, you know you’ve won the resource war.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 500: Han Li’s Lightning Sphere Sends Xuan Gu Into a Tailspin
twitter_description: Xuan Gu budgeted Han Li’s lightning to near-zero. That was his first—and possibly last—mistake.

lore_anchors.definition: Lightning released from golden lightning-bamboo; the ultimate nemesis of ghost-path and Yin-aligned techniques, capable of neutralizing cold Yin flames through positive-energy counterbalance.
An extreme-cold flame that freezes treasures and spiritual energy rather than burning them; a Yin-aligned high-tier flame newly acquired by Xuan Gu.
A legendary ghost-path sacred flame created by forcibly merging Profound Soul Yin Fire, black lightning, and Azure Frost Flame; extremely dangerous and prone to backlash.
A high-level technique within the Azure Origin Sword Art that temporarily manifests multiple solid flying swords from a single treasure.
A rare spiritual wood that naturally produces Yang-aligned Bane Lightning; treasures made from it are highly sought after as counters to evil and ghostly arts.
